02 / The Elicitation block, both shapes

{ "continue": false, "stopReason": R, "decision": "block", "reason": R }

2.1.284+ reads decision and declines the secret-bearing MCP form, as exit code 2 does. 2.1.277 to 2.1.283 ignore it, so continue:false stays to keep the block on the floor. The output guard only rewrites hookSpecificOutput, so both top-level keys reach CC (pinned in output-guard-cc-contract.test.ts).
